tools.send: Send a pad payload as this tab to an authorized target tab
tools.agent_report: Report as this tab using a Markdown file in its pad
tools.notify_send: Notify the owner from this tab using a pad payload

arguments.from_pad: Relative path to a payload file in this tab’s pad.
arguments.sha: Commit SHA produced by this task.
arguments.id: Record or task id to read.
arguments.title: Notification title.
